conditions.heating_method: dissolution at the boiling point of the solvent
conditions.cooling_method: sealed vessel placed in an ice-water bath

steps: crystals isolated from the test vessel

compounds.addition_profile: used at its boiling point to prepare a saturated solution

procedure_text:
A saturated solution of about 50 mg of tembotrione in the solvents stated in Table 1 was prepared in a test vessel at the boiling point of the solvent. The test vessel was sealed and placed in an ice-water bath and left there for about 40 mins. In this manner, tembotrione was obtained in the form of crystals, which were isolated and analyzed by X-ray powder diffractometry (XRD). On the basis of the characteristic reflections, form A was identified.
TABLE 1
| Example | Solvent | Crystal form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | acetic acid | small prisms, needles |
procedure_summary: A solution of tembotrione saturated in acetic acid at the boiling point of the solvent is sealed in a test vessel and held in an ice-water bath. The crystals that grow are isolated and identified as form A by X-ray powder diffractometry.
notes: This step is printed Example 2, the row of TABLE 1 whose solvent is acetic acid. Printed heading above the group: Examples 2-9, under the section heading Preparation of Form A of Tembotrione by Crystallization from an Organic Solvent with Cooling, which is the heading of Example 1 and is not repeated. READ THE TABLE COLUMN CORRECTLY: the column headed Crystal form gives the HABIT, printed here as small prisms, needles, and not the polymorph. The prose of [0074] identifies form A from the characteristic reflections for every row of this table, so product_name is the form A record for all eight steps and the habit is recorded here. Confusing habit with modification would invent seven products the document does not claim.
